terms: Fairy tale — genre featuring magical elements and moral lessons.
Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm — linguists who collected folktales; first edition Kinder- und Hausmärchen in 1812.
Once upon a time — formulaic opening of German Märchen.
Children abandoned in the forest who outwit a witch in her gingerbread house.
Simple past for narrative: 'es war einmal, sie ging, sie sah'.
Little Red Riding Hood — among the most famous Grimm tales.
